scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
